name: Exact data match (EDM)
short_description: A Microsoft Purview detection method that compares content against a hashed table of real sensitive values, such as customer account numbers, to reduce false positives compared with pattern matching.

evidence.quote: Exact data match asks a harder one.
o coincidencia exacta de IDs de empleados, usa alta severidad con bloqueo inmediato.
